method.direct: Exact, unambiguous label or exact-synonym match after mechanical recipe-line parsing only.
method.fallback: Exact match after the existing bounded standardizer plus vocabulary-validated final-token singularization.
method.threshold: Support >= 500 recipes and >= 3 supported concepts, evaluated on the legacy train split only.
method.unmatched: Retained as a local standalone concept; never discarded or mapped to UNK.
